data.aim: A closed loop for everything happening in an organisation. Contributions come from many kinds of people and from their AI tools; the MCP turns each one into structured records; the app shows them; people decide on them; what is still missing feeds the next contribution.

data.question: Which number says sharingu is working (the aim's measure)?
data.why: No measure was ever decided: the aim is stated with no number, and the checklist's aim item wants one. The options are the measures the sources propose; none is decided.

options.what: Weekly company goals with a useful contribution accepted and picked up by another contributor
options.tradeoff: The context pack's PROPOSED north star (a measurement proposal, not a current dashboard claim). Track organisation cohorts and human/agent roles so repeated automated writes do not inflate it.

options.what: Activated organisations: two different people (or a person and an agent acting for another contributor) complete a useful handoff against the same real goal
options.tradeoff: The context pack's proposed activation definition; BETA.md Stage C lists the first handoff among the beta measures. Sign-up, connection or generated text does not count.

options.what: Week-1 and week-4 return of activated organisations
options.tradeoff: The context pack's proposed retention measure; BETA.md Stage C lists week-1 and week-4 return among the beta measures.
